statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is 15 of 100 in the low band, ten points below the 25 block threshold, while stress stays extreme at 80 and confidence is high at 88.
recommendation: Tail sits in the low band, so the deterministic mapping returns EA_ON for both NQ futures and NAS100 CFD. The decisive evidence this hour is that the pre-bell high at 29,499.50 has now capped price for about three hours while NQ rotates roughly 55 points beneath it, and that the marginal cash extension to 29,473.12 was given back rather than held. That is the signature of a market still granting mean reversion. The named window covers 19:00 to 21:00 UTC, the final cash hour into the 20:00 UTC close on a Friday weekly expiry and the thin post-close futures hour before the 21:00 UTC weekend halt, where conditional tail peaks at 18 and still stays inside the low band. No slot in the forward window reaches the block threshold.
headline: The session high is holding and the volatility bid keeps draining: NQ trades 29,444.75 at 16:15 UTC, about 55 points under a 29,499.50 high that has capped for three hours, NDX is 29,406.06 for a 1.04% gain after fading a 29,473.12 extension, VIX is 15.68 at its session low and down 12.1%, and crude has retreated with WTI at 99.84 on reported Oman-track Hormuz diplomacy. Tail is 15 in the low band against extreme stress of 80.
body:
Both dated U.S. releases for Friday are verified and unchanged. The Bureau of Labor Statistics published the August consumer price report at 12:30 UTC: all items rose 0.4% on a seasonally adjusted basis and 3.4% over twelve months, while all items less food and energy rose 0.3% on the month and 2.4% over the year, with the core monthly figure a tenth above consensus. The University of Michigan preliminary September survey followed at 14:00 UTC at 47.8 against a 51.0 consensus and a 51.7 August final, a 7.5% monthly decline, with year-ahead inflation expectations jumping to 4.6% from 4.0% and the long-run measure at 3.4%.

The price path remains the decisive evidence and it has not deteriorated. NQ trades 29,444.75 at 16:15 UTC, essentially unchanged against the 29,442.50 observed an hour earlier, inside a 29,040.50 to 29,499.50 range. The 29,499.50 high was set before the cash bell and has now capped the market for roughly three hours. The cash index did push marginally higher, printing 29,473.12 against a 29,446.24 high an hour ago, but sits at 29,406.06 for a 1.04% gain, about 67 points below that extension. A marginal new high that is immediately given back, inside a session that keeps returning to the middle of its range, is two-way rotation beneath resistance. It is not the persistent no-retracement extension that the tail score measures, which is why tail eases to 15 rather than building toward the block threshold.

Volatility continues to drain rather than expand. VIX is 15.68, down 12.11%, printing its session low of 15.67 after trading as high as 17.71 earlier in the day. Internals remain aligned to the upside without becoming one-way, with semiconductors and most megacaps higher on the latest available session basis. Alignment of this kind is treated here as a mild amplifier for a possible late-session continuation leg, not as established structure.

The energy leg has clearly relaxed. WTI is 99.84, down 2.58% on a 98.51 to 104.46 range, and Brent is 105.26, down 2.20% from a Thursday peak near 108. Reporting attributes the retreat to Iranian state media indicating that Tehran will meet Gulf states in Oman to discuss the Strait of Hormuz, the first visible diplomatic track after a week of escalation, though the U.S. blockade of Iranian exports and the underlying dispute remain unresolved and both benchmarks still hold a weekly gain near 9%.

The cross-asset picture stays conflicted, which is why stress remains extreme while tail stays low. The two-year yield is 4.623%, up about 3.5 basis points, against a ten-year at 4.950% that is only 0.6 basis points higher on the day within a 4.904 to 4.985 range. That is a flat, hawkish curve response. Reported odds of a 25 basis point increase at the 16 September FOMC stand near 86% to 90%, up from about 72% a day earlier. Equities advancing more than 1% into a firmly priced rate increase is a conflict signal, and under this framework conflicting evidence raises stress and lowers directional conviction rather than mechanically raising tail.

The structure of the remaining session matters more than its direction. The August budget statement at 18:00 UTC is a low-sensitivity checkpoint. The final cash hour from 19:00 UTC carries the closing auction on a Friday weekly expiry immediately before an FOMC week, and the hour after the 20:00 UTC close runs on thin futures liquidity into the 21:00 UTC CME weekend halt. Those two hours form the named window, with conditional tail peaking at 18. From 21:00 UTC the forward window spends its remaining nineteen slots inside the closure, where no price path can form, so conditional tail falls to the weekend floor and residual risk becomes a gap into the Sunday 22:00 UTC reopen rather than tail.

lookbackSummary: All 24 clock-hours from 16:00 UTC on 10 September to 15:00 UTC on 11 September carry a published Claude assessment, so every lookback slot is available and none is reconstructed. The window opens at tail 16 with the mode mixed and holds a 15 to 19 band through that afternoon, recording event/whipsaw at 19 and 18 in the 20:00 and 21:00 UTC slots around the previous cash close. The overnight hours from 22:00 UTC normalised into an 11 to 15 band, the quietest stretch of the window, with stress pinned in the mid-80s throughout. From 06:00 UTC the mode turned trend-up at tail 13, 14, 13, 14, 15 and 14 as the pre-report advance extended while stress eased from 85 to 81. The two highest readings of the window sit in the 12:00 and 13:00 UTC slots at tail 21 and 22, both event/whipsaw and both mapped to WATCH, spanning the 12:30 UTC consumer price release, with confidence dropping to 70 and 80 as live evidence thinned around the print. The last two slots at 14:00 and 15:00 UTC returned to tail 15 and 16 and the mixed mode once the opening auction was observed to fade rather than extend, and that condition still holds at the start of the current window.
outlookSummary: The forward window covers the last five hours of the 11 September session and then spends its remaining nineteen slots inside the CME weekend closure that begins at 21:00 UTC. Conditional tail opens at 15 in the current slot, which contains observed rather than hypothetical structure, eases to 14 through the afternoon lull and returns to 15 for the 18:00 UTC budget statement. It peaks at 18 in the 19:00 UTC final cash hour, where closing-auction and Friday weekly-expiry flow concentrate ahead of an FOMC week, then settles to 15 for the thin post-close hour into the halt. Those two hours form the named window. From 21:00 UTC conditional tail collapses to the 5 to 7 weekend floor because no price path can form while the venue is shut, and conditional stress decays stepwise from 58 to a resting 34 as the live repricing premium is removed. Conditional confidence declines gradually from 88 to 66 with distance from the last verified observation. No slot in the window reaches the 25 block threshold, so every forward slot maps to EA_ON, and the residual weekend risk is carried as a gap into the Sunday 22:00 UTC reopen rather than as tail.
